title: 7-Day Four Seasons The Nam Hai Golf & Ocean Sanctuary
description: Forbes 5-Star luxury beach retreat at Four Seasons The Nam Hai. Play BRG Nicklaus, Ba Na Hills, and Hoiana Shores in ultimate luxury.

signatureTour.title: The Grand Vietnam Odyssey
signatureTour.highlight: Vietnam’s premier cross-country ultra-luxury odyssey combining Four Seasons Nam Hai with Capella Hanoi and Park Hyatt Saigon.

featuredVenues.name: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai

inclusions.detail: Private luxury chauffeured transfer for all airport and golf rounds.
3 rounds at BRG Da Nang (Nicklaus), Ba Na Hills, and Hoiana Shores.
6 nights in a Beachfront Pool Villa at Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai.
Singing bowl sound therapy and post-round muscle release.
Priority morning tee sheet access and dedicated bag-drop coordination.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Ha My Beachfront & Private Pool Villa Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Forbes 5-Star Welcome
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Da Nang International Airport where your private luxury transfer awaits. A short 25-minute drive brings you to the gates of Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai on pristine Ha My Beach. Settle into your beachfront pool villa, an architectural masterpiece inspired by ancient feng shui concepts with open pavilions and private ocean access.

Sip a welcome lemongrass cocktail while watching the surf roll onto the private white-sand beach. In the evening, enjoy dinner at La Sen restaurant, sampling modern interpretations of royal Vietnamese dishes.

itinerary.title: Tactical Water Hazards at BRG Da Nang (Nicklaus Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Nicklaus Waterfront Test
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course — Jack Nicklaus Design (Par 73, 7,380 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: BRG Da Nang Nicklaus Course championship golf course Jack Nicklaus Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Begin your championship schedule at the Nicklaus Design course at BRG Da Nang Golf Resort, located just 15 minutes north. Featuring authentic wooden bulkheads lining lakes and streams, this layout demands strategic placement and crisp ball-striking to navigate past water on almost every approach.

After your morning round, return to The Nam Hai for an afternoon by the iconic three-tiered beachfront infinity pool, followed by an evening sound bath meditation at The Heart of the Earth Spa.

itinerary.title: Cool Mountain Breezes at Ba Na Hills Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Donald Mountain Masterpiece
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald / IMG (Par 72, 7,858 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Ba Na Hills Golf Club championship golf course Luke Donald / IMG Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Ascend into the mist-clad hills to play Ba Na Hills Golf Club, Luke Donald’s mountain showpiece. Rolling fairways wind around towering rainforest ridges, with elevation changes offering stunning valley vistas and testing your club selection on every approach shot.

Enjoy lunch with panoramic views of the 18th green before an executive transfer returns you to the comfort of your private pool villa for a relaxing beachside afternoon.

itinerary.title: Ocean Sanctuary Leisure & The Heart of the Earth Spa
itinerary.subtitle: Forbes 5-Star Spa Immersion
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend a day fully immersed in the luxury of Four Seasons The Nam Hai. Start with beachfront yoga at dawn, followed by breakfast on the ocean terrace. Indulge in an exclusive 90-minute treatment at The Heart of the Earth Spa, featuring crystal singing bowls and therapeutic herbal bodywork.

In the evening, take a short private transfer into Hoi An Ancient Town for an exclusive candlelit dinner in a historic merchant courtyard arranged by your AGS concierge.

itinerary.title: Grand Coastal Links Finale at Hoiana Shores
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: RTJ II World Top 100 Links
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Hoiana Shores Golf Club — Robert Trent Jones Jr. (Par 72, 7,309 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Hoiana Shores Golf Club championship golf course Robert Trent Jones Jr. Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on Robert Trent Jones II’s links masterpiece, Hoiana Shores Golf Club. Exposed entirely to the coastal breezes of the East Sea, this pristine links features firm, fast Zeon Zoysia fairways that reward bump-and-run tactics and imaginative short-game creativity.

Celebrate the finale of your golf circuit with craft cocktails on the clubhouse terrace before returning to The Nam Hai for an exquisite private seafood beach barbecue right outside your villa.

itinerary.title: Bespoke Culinary & Beachfront Day of Rest
itinerary.subtitle: Private Beach Leisure
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Wake up to the sound of breaking waves and savor a relaxed tropical breakfast. Spend the day lounging on your beachfront sun terrace, kayaking along the Ha My shoreline, or taking a tailored Vietnamese cooking masterclass at the resort’s organic farm.

Gather for a final sunset dinner at The Nam Hai’s Beach Bar, sipping vintage champagne and reflecting on a magnificent week of world-class golf and ocean luxury.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Da Nang International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.stayName: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai
itinerary.imageCaption: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a final morning swim in your private pool before completing an effortless checkout coordinated by your personal Four Seasons villa host and AGS concierge.

Your private luxury transfer delivers your party to Da Nang International Airport in executive comfort, concluding your prestige golf vacation.

faqs.question: What makes The Nam Hai villas unique?
faqs.answer: Each villa features indoor/outdoor living, freestanding bathtubs, private sun decks, and unobstructed East Sea beachfront access.
